# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| `main` | ✅ |
| older | ❌ |

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security issue, **do not open a public issue.**

Instead, report it privately to Gauvreau Accounting Tax Law Advisory via:

- Email: security@gauvreaucpa.ca
- Or use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting (Security → Report a
  vulnerability) on this repository.

Please include:

- A description of the issue and its impact
- Steps to reproduce
- Any relevant logs or proof-of-concept (without exposing live credentials)

We aim to acknowledge reports within **3 business days** and will keep you
informed as we investigate and remediate.

## Scope notes

This repository is a **static site** and contains no backend or secrets. The
production automation tools referenced here handle sensitive legal and financial
data; those systems are covered by separate, stricter agreements and are not
part of this public repo.
